# Spin-Glass and XORSAT Benchmarks

This site currently documents the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick (SK) and three-dimensional Edwards--Anderson (EA3D) benchmark families and reports the available solver results. The EA3D instances are taken from Del Bono, Ricci-Tersenghi, and Zamponi (PNAS 2026) [@delbono2026]. Two-dimensional EA, sparse random graph spin glasses, and XORSAT problems are planned for future additions.

[Problem definition](problem_definition.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
[Results](results.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-lg}
